description: PLANNED for OpenVibe.Website Connect (audience openvibe.website, staff or operations only): read the operator view of shares, tunnels, hooks and quota counters (GET /api/v1/admin/shares and GET /api/v1/admin/shares/:id), beyond what the owner sees but still without tunnel tokens, hook secrets, request bodies or message content. This is the read half of the internal admin surface; a grant is never issued to user, app or agent tokens.
